summary.intent: Make the ask-soony web app installable as a PWA with web push notifications ("🔴 Launch at risk") where tapping the notification opens an "Answer" view that starts the voice conversation. iPhone requires adding to the home screen first.
summary.outcome: Implemented manifest, icons, service worker, push backend (pywebpush, VAPID keys, subscription storage, test endpoint), frontend push registration with an "Enable alerts" switch and an Answer view. Fixed a TypeScript error, rebuilt, restarted the inbox, verified PWA files, and committed on the voice branch.

repo: Backend is Python (src/ask_soony, with push.py and api.py); the frontend lives in web/ (Vite/React/TypeScript with App.tsx, index.html, public/ for sw.js and manifest.webmanifest).
web/dist is the served build output, so a failed TypeScript build leaves the old dist without the service worker; always rebuild successfully before verifying PWA files.
Push uses the repo's own VAPID keys and pywebpush; later critical alerts are meant to trigger push automatically via the same backend.
Work was committed on a dedicated voice branch.

code.finding: Push subscription key typing failed under newer TypeScript versions (applicationServerKey type) and needed a typing fix before the build passed.

workflow: Notification tap opens an Answer button instead of auto-starting the conversation, because browsers (especially iOS) only allow microphone/audio after a user gesture.
iOS web push only works for PWAs added to the home screen, so the install step is a prerequisite for testing on iPhone.
Run the build after adding TypeScript code; a type error blocks the build and leaves stale artifacts.

friction: TypeScript type error on the push key (Uint8Array/BufferSource typing in newer TS) blocked the first build and required a fix and rebuild.
open_items: Hook critical alerts to trigger push automatically (currently only a test endpoint exists).
Test on a real iPhone after Add to Home Screen, since iOS push behavior can't be verified from the desktop build.
Subscription storage and VAPID key handling may need hardening for production.
